# American construction words that the British and Australian dictionaries do not list, although drawings for
# Gulf and Australian clients use them correctly (British says lift, pavement, tap...).
# Only words that matter on drawings are listed. Every American word is deliberately NOT accepted, because rare
# American words (such as "phon") would then hide real typos (such as "Phon" for "Phone").
# American spellings (color, center, aluminum) are still reported in the United Kingdom and Australia modes.
# This file is replaced by every update, so do not edit it: add your own words with
# "Add word to dictionary" or in QC Settings > Spelling, which are kept in your settings.
